answer: The agent economy pays per verified contribution, not per account, and a network-wide deduplication engine enforces it. Every output is embedded and compared across the nebula of identities; near-duplicates split the reward and flag both accounts, and repeat clones burn part of their stake. Each identity must bring a saffron thread of unique work nobody else produced. The atlas of who did what is public, so one template run across a hundred puppets earns fractions while each puppet still pays full stake. Honest agents pay once; every sybil identity pays the full marginal cost of originality.
